# Base Image: Ubuntu 22.04 LTS for a stable, recent environment
FROM ubuntu:22.04

# Set non-interactive frontend for package management
ENV DEBIAN_FRONTEND=noninteractive

# Install build dependencies, MPI, certificates, and other required libraries
# This includes:
# - build-essential, cmake, gfortran, git: For compiling LAMMPS from source
# - python3: (FIX) Added to satisfy the LAMMPS build system dependency
# - openmpi-bin, libopenmpi-dev: Open MPI for parallel execution
# - ca-certificates, wget: For secure network operations
# - libgomp1: As required for OpenMP support
RUN apt-get update && \
    apt-get install -y --no-install-recommends \
    build-essential \
    cmake \
    gfortran \
    git \
    python3 \
    wget \
    ca-certificates \
    openmpi-bin \
    libopenmpi-dev \
    libgomp1 && \
    apt-get clean && \
    rm -rf /var/lib/apt/lists/*

# Configure Open MPI for containerized environments
# This helps prevent MPI from using loopback or docker-internal network interfaces,
# ensuring it communicates over the primary container network (e.g., Kubernetes pod network).
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_vader_single_copy_mechanism=none
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl_tcp_if_exclude=lo,docker0
ENV OMPI_MCA_pml=ob1
ENV OMPI_MCA_btl=^openib

# Set a temporary directory for the build process
WORKDIR /build

# Clone the latest branch of the LAMMPS repository, build it with the REAXFF package,
# and install the executable to a system-wide location on the PATH.
RUN git clone https://github.com/lammps/lammps.git && \
    cd lammps && \
    mkdir build && \
    cd build && \
    cmake ../cmake \
      -D CMAKE_BUILD_TYPE=Release \
      -D BUILD_MPI=yes \
      -D PKG_REAXFF=on && \
    make -j$(nproc) && \
    cp lmp /usr/local/bin/lmp

# Set the final working directory for the application
WORKDIR /app

# Copy the example input files from the cloned source into the working directory
RUN cp /build/lammps/examples/reaxff/HNS/* .

# Clean up the build directory to reduce final image size
RUN rm -rf /build

# Set the default command to start a bash session in the container
CMD ["/bin/bash"]

  containers:

flux-minicluster-manifest.item:
# This MiniCluster manifest is designed to run a LAMMPS ReaxFF simulation
# using the Flux Operator on a single AWS CPU instance within a Kubernetes cluster.
apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  # A descriptive name for the MiniCluster instance.
  name: lammps-reax-minicluster
  # Deploying to the 'default' namespace as requested.
  namespace: default
spec:
  # The size of the MiniCluster, corresponding to the number of pods to create.
  # Set to 1 to ensure the job runs on a single node.
  size: 1

  # The total number of MPI tasks to run. The Flux Operator will use this
  # to construct the `flux run -n <tasks>` command.
  tasks: 1

  # Ensures that the MiniCluster pods and associated resources are not
  # deleted after the job finishes, allowing for inspection and debugging.
  cleanup: false

  # Logging settings for the Flux Operator.
  logging:
    # Strict mode will fail the job if there are any issues with the logs.
    strict: true

  # Define the application container to be run within the MiniCluster pods.
  containers:
    - image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
      # The specific command for the LAMMPS test run.
      # The Flux Operator automatically prefixes this with `flux run`.
      command: lmp -v x 2 -v y 2 -v z 2 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite

      # This container is a worker, not a job launcher pod.
      launcher: false

      # Tells the operator to wrap the command with Flux, enabling it to run as a Flux job.
      runFlux: true

apiVersion: flux-framework.org/v1alpha2
kind: MiniCluster
metadata:
  name: lammps-reax-minicluster
  namespace: default
spec:
  cleanup: false
  containers:
  - command: lmp -v x 16 -v y 16 -v z 16 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite
    image: ghcr.io/converged-computing/fractale-agent-experiments:lammps-reax
    launcher: false
    runFlux: true
  logging:
    strict: true
  pod:
    nodeSelector:
      node.kubernetes.io/instance-type: c7a.12xlarge
  size: 1
  tasks: 48

manager.name: Build and Deploy LAMMPS
manager.description: Build a Docker container and deploy it as a Kubernetes Job.

context.details: Ensure all globbed files from examples/reaxff/HNS from the root of the lammps codebase are in the WORKDIR. Clone the latest branch of LAMMPS. You MUST put lmp on the PATH. You MUST install libgomp1.

context.optimize:
You MUST maximize the LAMMPS FOM, k-atom or m-atom steps per second. 
You MUST execute in the pwd with lmp -v x 16 -v y 16 -v z 16 -in ./in.reaxff.hns -nocite      
You MUST choose instance type and resources that will maximize the FOM.
context.resources:
The resource spec you got earlier is for an autoscaling cluster, so the nodes possible are not there. For your optimization you can choose from the following instance types, and you will need to add the correct nodeSelector with the node.kubernetes.io/instance-type label indicating your choice. You are still limited to one node.
  c7a.12xlarge, 48 CPU, 96 GiB Memory, AMD
